meta.group: A Guide for Developers Traveling Through OpenLayers
subtitle: The biggest difference between WFS and WMS lies in the result of the data. WFS returns spatial elements as GeoJSON, while WMS directly renders a map based on the spatial elements and provides that. OpenLayers renders objects onto a `canvas` based on WFS data. Think of it as drawing a kind of shape based on the spatial information. Unlike images, since these are objects drawn directly on the web, the web has the great advantage of being able to recognize or manipulate them.
